raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview Run the FlashInfer DCP prefill context pass on the trtllm-gen context kernel (non-causal, with LSE) instead of the native FlashInfer kernel, under the same conditions in which non-DCP prefill auto-selects trtllm-gen. No existing PR switches this kernel; #58519 is complementary (it reduces overhead around the same pass). ## Claims - On 8×B200 (TP8, DCP2), 100k input / 512 output: mean TTFT −39–48% and output throughput 1.23–1.79× across concurrency 1–32. - On 4×B200 (TP4, DCP2) with GLM-4-9B, same workload: mean TTFT −37–44% and output throughput 1.26–1.68× across concurrency 1–32. - Accuracy matches the native path (MRCR, GSM8K), and a new kernel test checks the pass against the native one. - Applies on SM100/SM103 when trtllm-gen prefill is available (`--attention-config.use_trtllm_attention` not 0) with an unquantized KV cache, to layers without a sliding window or soft-capping. Other layers keep the native kernel. ## Validation Qwen3-30B-A3B, TP8 / DCP2 / EP8, a2a DCP combine, prefix caching off, one run per arm. | Concurrency | Output tok/s | Mean TTFT ms | Mean TPOT ms | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | 106.9 → 131.5 (1.23×) | 2190 → 1332 | 5.1 → 5.0 | | 2 | 151.3 → 204.6 (1.35×) | 3203 → 1881 | 7.0 → 6.1 | | 4 | 190.8 → 287.2 (1.51×) | 5061 → 2832 | 11.1 → 8.4 | | 8 | 221.7 → 364.9 (1.65×) | 8722 → 4675 | 19.0 → 12.8 | | 16 | 239.3 → 414.0 (1.73×) | 12875 → 6792 | 41.6 → 25.3 | | 32 | 250.7 → 448.8 (1.79×) | 16277 → 8460 | 95.6 → 54.5 | TPOT improves at higher concurrency only because decode steps share batches with shorter prefill chunks. GLM-4-9B-chat (32 Q / 2 KV heads), 4×B200, TP4 / DCP2, a2a DCP combine, prefix caching off, one run per arm. | Concurrency | Output tok/s | Mean TTFT ms | Mean TPOT ms | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | 90.3 → 113.9 (1.26×) | 3220 → 2019 | 4.8 → 4.8 | | 2 | 117.9 → 162.2 (1.38×) | 4851 → 3073 | 7.5 → 6.3 | | 4 | 140.2 → 209.8 (1.50×) | 7836 → 4837 | 13.2 → 9.6 | | 8 | 154.4 → 245.4 (1.59×) | 13599 → 8145 | 25.3 → 16.7 | | 16 | 163.2 → 270.1 (1.66×) | 24774 → 14267 | 49.7 → 31.4 | | 32 | 168.1 → 282.6 (1.68×) | 33043 → 18366 | 125.9 → 77.4 | | Eval (real weights) | Native | trtllm-gen | |---|---|---| | MRCR match ratio (40 samples) | 0.480 | 0.496 | | GSM8K (1319 questions, 5-shot) | 0.888 | 0.899 | Both accuracy differences are within noise. A kernel-level comparison against the native kernel (all layers and ranks, real metadata) gave max relative output error 2.3e-4 and matching LSE. These runs used an earlier revision of this PR that was opt-in through an env var and included `q_scale` (1.0 for this checkpoint) in `bmm1_scale`; the kernel path is otherwise unchanged. `pytest tests/kernels/attention/test_flashinfer_trtllm_attention.py -k dcp_prefill` on B200: TODO.
Commands ```bash # Baseline: the parent commit. --load-format dummy for perf vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B --tensor-parallel-size 8 --decode-context-parallel-size 2 --dcp-comm-backend a2a \ --enable-expert-parallel --moe-backend flashinfer_trtllm --max-model-len 128000 --max-num-seqs 256 \ --no-enable-prefix-caching --generation-config vllm vllm bench serve --backend openai --dataset-name random --random-input-len 100000 --random-output-len 512 \ --random-range-ratio 0 --num-prompts $((C*4 < 8 ? 8 : C*4)) --max-concurrency $C --request-rate inf --ignore-eos --seed 0 python tests/evals/mrcr/mrcr_eval.py --port 8000 --num-samples 40 --concurrency 8 python tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py --port 8000 --num-questions 1319 --max-concurrency 64 # GLM-4-9B on 4 GPUs: same bench command vllm serve THUDM/glm-4-9b-chat-hf --tensor-parallel-size 4 --decode-context-parallel-size 2 --dcp-comm-backend a2a \ --attention-backend FLASHINFER --max-model-len 128000 --max-num-seqs 256 --max-num-batched-tokens 32768 \ --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 --no-enable-prefix-caching --generation-config vllm --load-format dummy \ --compilation-config '{"custom_ops":["all"]}' ```
## Details - **Kernel.** `trtllm_batch_context_with_kv_cache(causal=False, return_lse=True)` over the DCP-local paged KV. Its LSE is base 2 like the native kernel's, so the combine and merge are unchanged. Non-causal mode and LSE output (flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#3020, #3116) postdate the original FlashInfer DCP support (#25438). The native context wrapper is not planned when this kernel runs. - **Requests with no local context.** The kernel's LSE for these rows is unspecified: FlashInfer computes it from softmax stats in the reused workspace, which the kernel never writes for `kv_len == 0`. Stale values corrupted the merge intermittently. These rows are masked as empty shards in the combine (`seq_lens` / `query_start_loc`), as on the trtllm DCP decode path, and the output is zero-initialized because the all-gather combine multiplies it by a zero weight. - **Test.** `test_flashinfer_dcp_prefill_trtllm_context` compares the pass with the native one, including requests with no local context, and runs in the "(B200) Kernels" CI job. The GQA DCP end-to-end test in `tests/distributed/test_context_parallel.py` needs 4 GPUs and only runs on SM90, so it does not cover Blackwell. - **Limitations.** FP8 KV keeps the native kernel; FlashInfer DCP with FP8 KV currently fails at startup on SM100 independently of this PR, to be fixed separately. `use_trtllm_attention=0` disables this together with trtllm-gen decode, as it does for non-DCP prefill. ---

(Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

Thanks for this. The speedup reproduces on GB300. I tested this head (e84ed09ac0) and opened a proposed restructuring against your branch, so it can be folded in here rather than duplicated: GagandeepKang-cohere/vllm#1 (one commit on top of e84ed09ac0).

**What it changes**
- `TrtllmDCPContextWrapper` implements the native context wrapper's `plan()`/`run()`. `BatchDCPPrefillWrapper.plan()` picks one per step, so `run()`, `forward()` and the DCP combine call stay unchanged (`flashinfer.py` +113/−2 vs main).
- It reuses the native plan's pinned CPU metadata. Requests without local context are handled inside the pass.
- Steps whose trtllm-gen LSE scratch (`num_qo_heads * batch_size * round_up(max_q_len, 256) * 8 B + 1 MiB`) would not fit the 394 MiB workspace fall back to the native kernel. That scratch scales with request count × longest query, and spec-decode verify queries take this path under DCP.

**Two issues on this head** (4×GB300, GLM-4-9B-chat TP4/DCP2 a2a; Qwen3-30B-A3B needs TP8 for DCP2)
- Calling the context pass with 1×8192 + 256×4 query tokens and 64 Q heads fails with `Buffer overflow ... trtllm_gen_softmax_workspace with size 1078984704 ... only 413138944 bytes available`. I only reproduced this at the kernel level, not end to end.
- GSM8K with `--max-num-batched-tokens 512` hangs the engine (5/5 runs): workers spin at 100% GPU with the DCP pairs in different collectives. It still hangs with the mask applied locally and with `VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_SYMM_MEM=0`. I have not found the root cause.

| | Native | This PR | Proposal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mean TTFT, C=1/8/32 (s), 100k in / 512 out | 2.96 / 12.4 / 30.1 | 1.90 / 7.57 / 17.1 | 1.98 / 7.54 / 17.0 |
| GSM8K, 512-token chunks | 0.646 | hang | 0.638 |

Full results, commands and limitations are in the draft. Happy to adjust it to fit your branch.

detail.title: [Attention] Use trtllm-gen for the FlashInfer DCP prefill context pass

files.patch:
@@ -645,3 +645,119 @@ def test_flashinfer_trtllm_prefill_with_baseline(
         torch.testing.assert_close(output, output_trtllm, atol=atol, rtol=rtol),
         f"{torch.max(torch.abs(output - output_trtllm))}",
     )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_heads", [(8, 1), (16, 2)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dcp_world_size", [2, 8])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("head_size", [64, 128, 256])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("block_size", [16, 64])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("context_lens", [[0, 37, 1000, 0, 4096], [0, 0]])
+@torch.inference_mode
+def test_flashinfer_dcp_prefill_trtllm_context(
+    num_heads: tuple[int, int],
+    dcp_world_size: int,
+    head_size: int,
+    block_size: int,
+    context_lens: list[int],
+) -> None:
+    """The trtllm-gen DCP context pass matches the native one, and gives
+    requests without local context a zero output and a -inf LSE."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.flashinfer import BatchDCPPrefillWrapper
+
+    set_random_seed(42)
+    device = "cuda"
+    dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    num_blocks = 4096 // block_size * len(context_lens) + 1
+    num_qo_heads, num_kv_heads = num_heads
+    sm_scale = head_size**-0.5
+
+    batch_size = len(context_lens)
+    ctx_lens = torch.tensor(context_lens, dtype=torch.int32)
+    q_lens = torch.randint(1, 64, (batch_size,), dtype=torch.int32)
+    qo_indptr = torch.zeros(batch_size + 1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    torch.cumsum(q_lens, dim=0, out=qo_indptr[1:])
+    num_pages = (ctx_lens + block_size - 1) // block_size
+    kv_indptr = torch.zeros(batch_size + 1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    torch.cumsum(num_pages, dim=0, out=kv_indptr[1:])
+    last_page_lens = ctx_lens - (num_pages - 1).clamp(min=0) * block_size
+
+    max_pages = max(int(num_pages.max()), 1)
+    block_tables = torch.randperm(num_blocks, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)[
+        : batch_size * max_pages
+    ].view(batch_size, max_pages)
+    kv_indices = torch.cat(
+        [block_tables[i, :n] for i, n in enumerate(num_pages.tolist())]
+    )
+
+    # K and V packed in the head dim, as in the FlashInfer backend's KV cache.
+    kv_cache = torch.randn(
+        num_blocks, num_kv_heads, block_size, 2 * head_size, dtype=dtype, device=device
+    )
+    kv_cache_tuple = kv_cache.split(head_size, dim=-1)
+    # The context pass sees the query heads of all DCP ranks.
+    query = torch.randn(
+        int(qo_indptr[-1]),
+        num_qo_heads * dcp_world_size,
+        head_size,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        device=device,
+    )
+    workspace = torch.zeros(128 * 1024 * 1024, dtype=torch.uint8, device=device)
+
+    def run_context(use_trtllm_context):
+        wrapper = BatchDCPPrefillWrapper(
+            "HND", workspace, use_trtllm_context=use_trtllm_context
+        )
+        wrapper.plan(
+            qo_indptr_cpu=qo_indptr,
+            paged_kv_indptr_cpu=kv_indptr,
+            paged_kv_indices=kv_indices,
+            paged_kv_last_page_len_cpu=last_page_lens,
+            kv_lens_cpu=ctx_lens,
+            page_size=block_size,
+            num_qo_heads=num_qo_heads,
+            dcp_world_size=dcp_world_size,
+            num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads,
+            head_dim=head_size,
+            sm_scale=sm_scale,
+            window_left=-1,
+            logits_soft_cap=None,
+            q_data_type=dtype,
+            kv_cache_dtype=dtype,
+            prefill_fixed_split_size=-1,
+            # Split-KV scratch for the native pass would not fit the workspace.
+            disable_split_kv=True,
+            block_tables=block_tables,
+        )
+        assert (wrapper._context is wrapper._trtllm_context) == use_trtllm_context
+        return wrapper._context.run(
+            query, kv_cache_tuple, k_scale=1.0, v_scale=1.0, return_lse=True
+        )
+
+    output, lse = run_context(True)
+    has_context = torch.repeat_interleave(ctx_lens > 0, q_lens).to(device)
+    assert torch.all(output[~has_context] == 0)
+    assert torch.all(lse[~has_context] == float("-inf"))
+    if not has_context.any():
+        return
+
+    ref_output, ref_lse = run_context(False)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        output[has_context], ref_output[has_context], atol=1e-2, rtol=1e-2
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        lse[has_context], ref_lse[has_context], atol=1e-2, rtol=1e-3
+    )
+
+
+def test_trtllm_dcp_context_workspace_fit() -> None:
+    """Batches whose LSE scratch exceeds the trtllm-gen workspace fall back to
+    the native context pass."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.flashinfer import TrtllmDCPContextWrapper
+
+    # One 8K prefill chunk plus 256 speculative-decode verify queries.
+    q_lens = torch.tensor([8192] + [4] * 256, dtype=torch.int32)
+    qo_indptr = torch.zeros(q_lens.shape[0] + 1, dtype=torch.int32)

Thanks for this. The speedup reproduces on GB300. I tested this head (e84ed09ac0) and opened a proposed restructuring against your branch, so it can be folded in here rather than duplicated: GagandeepKang-cohere/vllm#1 (one commit on top of e84ed09ac0).

**What it changes**
- `TrtllmDCPContextWrapper` implements the native context wrapper's `plan()`/`run()`. `BatchDCPPrefillWrapper.plan()` picks one per step, so `run()`, `forward()` and the DCP combine call stay unchanged (`flashinfer.py` +113/−2 vs main).
- It reuses the native plan's pinned CPU metadata. Requests without local context are handled inside the pass.
- Steps whose trtllm-gen LSE scratch (`num_qo_heads * batch_size * round_up(max_q_len, 256) * 8 B + 1 MiB`) would not fit the 394 MiB workspace fall back to the native kernel. That scratch scales with request count × longest query, and spec-decode verify queries take this path under DCP.

**Two issues on this head** (4×GB300, GLM-4-9B-chat TP4/DCP2 a2a; Qwen3-30B-A3B needs TP8 for DCP2)
- Calling the context pass with 1×8192 + 256×4 query tokens and 64 Q heads fails with `Buffer overflow ... trtllm_gen_softmax_workspace with size 1078984704 ... only 413138944 bytes available`. I only reproduced this at the kernel level, not end to end.
- GSM8K with `--max-num-batched-tokens 512` hangs the engine (5/5 runs): workers spin at 100% GPU with the DCP pairs in different collectives. It still hangs with the mask applied locally and with `VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_SYMM_MEM=0`. I have not found the root cause.

| | Native | This PR | Proposal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mean TTFT, C=1/8/32 (s), 100k in / 512 out | 2.96 / 12.4 / 30.1 | 1.90 / 7.57 / 17.1 | 1.98 / 7.54 / 17.0 |
| GSM8K, 512-token chunks | 0.646 | hang | 0.638 |

Full results, commands and limitations are in the draft. Happy to adjust it to fit your branch.
